below-3: For most people, no extra sun protection is needed at this UV level.
3-to-8: Cover exposed skin, wear a broad-brimmed hat and UV-protective sunglasses, and use shade.
Apply broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen generously to uncovered skin before going outside.
8-plus: Cover exposed skin, wear a broad-brimmed hat and UV-protective sunglasses.
Apply broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen generously to uncovered skin before going outside.
Limit direct sun and prioritize shade while UV is this strong.
